sasha: Quick sync — Aurora's onboarding account (acct_aurora) hit a 3x token spend spike overnight. Seeing lots of embed heavy calls. Need an ask for QBR: short forecast, warning to account, and enablement session. Any immediate blockers?

lina: On it. I pulled the spend heatmap, looks like 80% embeddings on 512-dim with no caching. Could be caused by batch replays from their ETL job. cc @jordan

jordan: @lina can you paste the query id or a snippet? I can check routing and prefix cache misses.

lina: Query sample: ```SELECT job_id, call_count, avg_tokens FROM embed_logs WHERE account='acct_aurora' AND ts > now()-24h ORDER BY call_count DESC LIMIT 5;``` returns job_id=etl-x12 call_count=154k avg_tokens=820

matthew: If avg_tokens=820 and they use hosted streaming with no prefix, batching inefficiency will cost. Recommend temp throttle and schedule enablement to cover caching + quantization options. Propose a 30-min QBR prep: run quick token forecast and produce 30/60/90 day projections.

sasha: Agree. Lina — can you run a 7-day rolling forecast and push a spend alert at 90% of their current monthly commit? We want to nudge before surprise invoice.

lina: Will do. Pulling last 7 days now — ETA 20m. Also drafting a short note for the account: "Heads up: Early usage patterns indicate embed-heavy workload; we recommend applying prefix caching + batching changes. Let's schedule a 30-min runbook review."

finops-bot: Alert created: alert_id=ALRT-20260321-007, threshold=90% commit, notify=acct-owners + cs-team

jordan: FYI I checked routing logs — 12% of their calls went to lower-tier quantized variant which increased tokenization overhead. I'll open a ticket to pin to the better variant for the QBR window.

sasha: Great. For the QBR deck bullet points: 1) delta vs forecast 2) recommended config changes (cache, batching, model variant) 3) action items & owner 4) ask for commit or quota bump. Who owns slide 2?

matthew: I'll take slide 2 config recs. Lina can own slide 3 (action items) and Jordan handle the technical appendix.

lina: Noted. I'll also include a short playbook snippet for customer ops: ```actions: - enable_prefix_cache: true - batching_target: 128 - embed_dim_recommendation: 256 if possible - quantize_variant: recommended``` keeps it short for the account email.

sasha: Perfect. Capture any feedback from the onboarding engineer — invite them to the QBR. Draft email when alert fires, please.

lina: Drafted. Will send once finops-bot confirms threshold hit. Slack thread closed unless new blockers.

jordan: One more: recommend a follow-up telemetry check 48 hours after config changes. I'll add that to slide 3.

matthew: Thanks all. Quick PR to the runbook after this. :thumbsup:

sasha: Thanks team — will circle back after forecasts. :eyes:
